items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Nora. Nora. Nora Dutry? Was he ever been to the Craytax?

ctx.x: Dutry. Oh, Dutry, yeah. But I know the young one, the son.
Yeah, yeah. He was playing with Amos too. And the time I'm playing, I forget his name. Nora. Nora. Nora Dutry? Was he ever been to the Craytax? Honoré.
